items.title: 6.9% Of ChatGPT Conversations Showed Purchase Intent In U.S. Panel
items.excerpt: U.S. panel data finds only 6.9% of ChatGPT conversations show intent to buy and most responses name no brand, a new input for teams weighing ChatGPT visibility and ChatGPT ads.

items.title: ChatGPT Ads Vs. Google Search Ads: What Early Data Shows
items.excerpt: ChatGPT competes for ad budgets, but revenue and survey data don't show how much has left search; its ad visits earned less in early data, and per-dollar returns are still estimates.
items.note: may overlap 11-03 ChatGPT ads revenue-per-visit paper; check for new data

items.title: Daydream's new AI agent acts as your personal stylist — and can shop for you, too
items.excerpt: Daydream's new AI shopping agent remembers your style, virtually tries on clothes, plans outfits around your wardrobe, tracks sales and completes purchases for you.

items.title: Google expands access to Gemini Tasks, which can help with calls, purchases
items.excerpt: Gemini's Task mode (formerly Spark), now free in six countries, can coordinate calls to businesses, log into websites and make purchases on the user's behalf via Visa and Mastercard tokens.
items.note: same story also on ppc.land and The Verge

items.title: Salesforce and Microsoft Announce Copilotforce, Bringing Salesforce Customer Context and Sales Workflows to Microsoft Copilot
items.excerpt: New integrations bring Salesforce customer context and sales workflows into Microsoft Copilot and enable real-time CRM collaboration in Microsoft Teams.

items.title: Salesforce joins the Personal Agent Protocol to help brands meet shoppers' AI agents
items.excerpt: Salesforce is a launch partner for Sierra and Meta's Personal Agent Protocol (Poppy) 1.0, which lets shoppers' personal agents find a store, prove identity and sign in, then hands cart and checkout to UCP in Commerce Cloud.

items.title: How brands can welcome AI users onto their sites this holiday season
items.excerpt: Customers are experimenting with AI shopping, but the on-site experience for AI-referred shoppers needs to feel easy and push them to complete the purchase.

items.title: Websites Aren't Just For People Anymore. Here's How Marketers Optimize Them For Agents
items.excerpt: Knotch's new AI marketing product, built on its Ace solution, makes brand website content more accessible to AI agents to improve discoverability in LLMs.

items.title: A Crash Course in Marketing to Machines
items.excerpt: Customers increasingly ask AI assistants what to buy; ADWEEK explains how brands can make sure the evidence those assistants find points to them.

items.title: Deloitte Digital's new agentic tools aim to fix messy marketing workflows
items.excerpt: Deloitte Digital's Converge Front Office suite links marketers' AI stacks with agents; Converge Sales agents identify prospects, engage inbound buyers and manage sales pipeline activity.

items.title: Holiday marketing hits inflection point in 2026: What brands need to know
items.excerpt: Consumers' push-pull relationship with AI in shopping and with creator tie-ups is forcing brands to rebalance holiday marketing; over a third say they are very willing to use generative AI tools to shop.
items.note: AI is one theme of a broader holiday piece; weak

items.title: Google Ads Brand Guidelines Add Visual Guidelines
items.excerpt: Google Ads added visual guidelines to Performance Max brand guidelines, letting advertisers add style references and preferences to steer how images are created and enhanced for their ads.

items.title: Google Ads Search Journey Awareness Help Document
items.excerpt: Google Ads published a help document on Search Journey Awareness, a Smart Bidding improvement that tracks the path from first click to sale to feed more data to Google AI for bidding.
items.note: help doc for an existing feature; weak

items.title: Amazon says under 0.1% of DVA ads on outside websites hit unsafe pages
items.excerpt: Amazon's new help pages say English-language web inventory is crawled by AmazonAdBot and risky pages are sent to AI models including Claude, keeping fewer than 1 in 1,000 DVA impressions on unsafe pages.

items.title: One Meta ad can now carry up to 5 existing posts
items.excerpt: Each person sees the post Meta's system predicts they will engage with, so advertisers promoting organic posts hand Meta the pick; the setup sits beside Advantage+ creative video generation.

items.title: Microsoft's AI Campaign Creation Available in US, Canada, UK and Australia
items.excerpt: AI-powered Performance Max campaign creation is now available to new Microsoft Advertising customers in the US, Canada, UK and Australia.
items.note: off-list domain (on-list searchengineland is hard-blocked); feature first shown Oct 28

items.title: Microsoft Upgrades Search Term Reporting and Adds AI Max Landing Page Report
items.excerpt: Microsoft Advertising adds an AI Max landing page report and enhanced segmentation to search term reporting for its dynamic AI Max targeting.
items.note: off-list domain; on-list searchengineland covers it but is hard-blocked
